reactor_type: Fiji F2002LL remote-plasma ALD reactor with hollow cathode plasma source
evidence: GaN, InN, and In xGa 12xN thin films were deposited at 200 °C in a modified Fiji F2002LL remote2plasma ALD reactor... The rotation speed of the Adixen ATH 400 M turbo pump was adjusted in order to keep the reactor pressure fixed at ~150 mTorr during growth sessions... Step 3 is TEG pulse followed by 10 s of purge time. After that, N 2/H 2 plasma is introduced as a second reactant followed by purging. Step 7 is 10 s exposure of N 2 plasma followed by purging.
